this_title: Snuff Reel: When Death Becomes Art
trans_title: 鼻烟卷:当死亡成为艺术
introduction: A young Art Student Kirsty Ruler becomes obsessed and aroused by the idea of turning fear and death into a masterpiece. Not only does she love the deep red of her friends blood but she loves the feel of cold dead skin. Detective Beckett is on her case and will soon bring her down from the careless blood trail that Kirsty leaves behind her.- Written by Maria Lee Metheringham
